content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
Meridian Supply GmbH
Industriestrasse 14, 68199 Mannheim, Deutschland
USt-IdNr: DE 811 223 344

RECHNUNG / INVOICE

Rechnungsnummer: MS-2025-4482
Rechnungsdatum: 27.11.2025
Zahlungsbedingungen: Zahlbar innerhalb 14 Tagen

Kunde: Falkner Bau AG, Basel

-------------------------------------------------------------
 POS  BEZEICHNUNG                MENGE   PREIS      BETRAG
-------------------------------------------------------------
  1   Industrial work gloves       20     5.95      119.00
  2   Safety goggles, clear        10    11.90      119.00
-------------------------------------------------------------
                                   GESAMTBETRAG:    238.00 EUR

Alle Preise inkl. 19% MwSt. (All prices include 19% VAT.)
Bankverbindung: Sparkasse Mannheim, IBAN DE44 5005 0201 0000 0000 00

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "Meridian Supply GmbH",
  "invoice_number": "MS-2025-4482",
  "invoice_date": "2025-11-27",
  "due_date": "2025-12-11",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "subtotal": 200.00,
  "tax_amount": 38.00,
  "total": 238.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Industrial work gloves", "quantity": 20, "unit_price": 5.00, "amount": 100.00},
    {"description": "Safety goggles, clear", "quantity": 10, "unit_price": 10.00, "amount": 100.00}
  ]
}
```
